raw_text: Nepal and China sign framework agreement for Kerung-Kathmandu trans-Himalayan railway. Chinese financing worth USD 3.5 billion. This is a BRI signature project that would give China direct rail access through the Himalayas. Indian security establishment deeply concerned about strategic implications for the open India-Nepal border.
